gui.panel.capture.title: Capture
gui.capture.no_classes: This project has no classes yet (or no project is open). Create classes such as Rock, Paper, Scissors first, then start capturing.
gui.capture.need_project: Open a project and create classes before capturing.
gui.capture.need_camera: Add and select a camera first, and wait for the picture before capturing.
gui.capture.save_failed: Could not save: {error}. Check the disk space and folder permissions, then try again.
gui.capture.block_bad: Do not capture when quality is poor
gui.capture.blocked: Quality is poor, so nothing was captured: {reason}
gui.capture.similar: This looks like the last photo. Try another angle or position.
gui.capture.still: Capture automatically when the picture is still
gui.capture.still_tip: Captures once when the picture stays still. It waits for movement and stillness again before the next photo.
gui.capture.still_wait: Waiting for the picture to be still...
gui.capture.ref_show: Show the reference on the picture
gui.capture.ref_none: No reference yet. Overlay one good photo to keep every photo framed the same way.
gui.capture.ref_bad: Cannot read "{name}". Please choose a complete photo file.
gui.capture.balance_low: "{name}" has the fewest photos. Capture more of it.
